nom: PÜR Minerals Sea Fresh Purifying Gel Foam Cleanser

segments.oily: Oily and oily-combo reviewers are split: some say the gel foam finally cleans their skin without leaving residue, while others report it left their face feeling oily or triggered breakouts and mint-related irritation.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry/combination and very sensitive skin reports the cleanser broke her out and left her face feeling dirty and greasy rather than clean.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report mixed results, from breakouts around the chin and cheeks to praise for a lather that cleans without stripping.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers say the cleanser does not strip or irritate and leaves skin calm and hydrated, though one very sensitive/dry-combination reviewer reports rashes, bumps and breakouts, and another flags that the peppermint oil can be an issue for some people.

concerns.spots: Several reviewers with oily or combination skin report the mint scent seemed to trigger breakouts around the cheeks or chin; others with oily or sensitive skin report no new breakouts and describe clearer, refreshed skin.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer describes small bumps and rash-like breakouts all over her face and neck after use; other reviewers, including sensitive-skin users, report no blemish issues and note the cleanser gets skin clean without irritation.
concerns.oiliness: Reports are mixed: one oily-skin reviewer says the cleanser finally worked for her oily skin, while another oily-combo reviewer says her face still felt oily after use and worked better with her old cleanser.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with dry/combination sensitive skin reports rashes and irritation along her chin and neck; another reviewer with oily skin reports the mint scent caused irritation.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers, including those with sensitive skin, report the cleanser does not strip natural oils and leaves skin feeling hydrated rather than dry or stripped after washing.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the cleanser as hydrating and non-stripping, leaving skin soft rather than dry after use, with no dissent noted on this point.

aspects.libelle: Mint scent irritates or triggers breakouts

extraits.texte: This face wash did not work for my skin type . I have dry/combination and VERY sensitive skin. It broke me out all along my chin and neck. I haven't had ache in years. 2 hours after using it my face felt really dirty and greasy. The rashes were accompanied by small bumps all over my face and neck. I think if I washed my face with WATER I would have been better off. If you have sensitive skin STAY FAR AWAY.

extraits.titre: Not for someone with oily skin
extraits.texte: Oily combo skin here, and I have to say it doesn't work for me. Especially with the mint scent that causes irritation to my skin. Having almost completed the bottle trying to give it a chance and my skin has only become worse because of it. Tonight finally went back to my old face wash and immediately felt the difference in the cleaning of oils it does as this face wash always left me felling a little oily no matter how much soap I used.

Didnt really do much to my face, if anything i did break out around my cheeks a bit. I have oily skin and the minty scent probably triggered the acne. I wanted to really wanted to like it but my face doesnt even feel truly cleaned.

extraits.titre: This Cleanser will definitely become my Go-To!
extraits.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin, not to mention oily, especially in my Tzone. I always apply cleansers and moisturizers twice a day, usually morning and night! This cleanser is truly amazing. If you are one for scents, this is a must-have! Refreshing, not stripping, and clearly hydrating! Even after one use, you can feel the difference in texture of your skin! Can't wait to see the drastic difference applying this every day! xo

This product is awesome! I have very sensitive skin, and this is one of the few cleansers where I feel it gets the job done without irritating or stripping my skin. I love the texture of it and the scent is so refreshing. I have no complaints. Also- let's talk about how fabulous the packaging is that the pump locks so it makes it easier to travel with!

This is a fresh cleanser thar removes make up well. The scent reminds me of Aveda products. The ingredients include pepermint oil which some people dont tolerate well. But I had no issue and I do have sensitive skin.
Finally found a product that is good for my oily skin type! Hope Ultra continues Pur products online cause they have become unavailable in my store location!
